text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah... She woke me up in the middle of the night crying, 'Senior, get this bug out of my room!'

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm plenty used to getting rid of bugs,
and you're always welcome to rely on me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Still, sleepy is sleepy.
Guess I'll take a nap later!

It seems Katsuragi Ace wasn't able
to get a good rest...
